messages:
samir: Hey @joanne — need short-lived prod admin to inspect ingestor logs in redwood-prod to validate redaction fix. Will query several requests; need access for 45m, starting now if approved. Ticket IR-4567. Will not change configs. :pray:

joanne: Can you post the exact queries and resources you'll touch? Also add the rollback plan. We'll need the KMS audit and a note in the access log.

samir: Will only read logs and list pods. Commands:
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.module="ingestor"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=200
kubectl --namespace=ingest get pods --selector=app=ingestor -o wide
```
No writes. Rollback: none required; just close session. Will capture timestamps.

nora: cc @sec-bot for automated grant. Also add `redaction-tests` tag to the access reason.

sec-bot: Access request logged: AR-202603-89. Policy check: SSO role 'prod-audit-read' available. Suggested max duration 60m. Approver @joanne.

joanne: :thumbsup: Approved for 45m starting 1764123456. Please use ephemeral `prod-audit-read` role. Notify when done and paste the session id.

samir: Got it, applying now. Will paste session id when created.

eng-oncall-bot: Note: Creating temporary group membership and audit entry. Reminder — any downloads of logs require DLP review.

nora: If you hit any unredacted PII, stop and DM me immediately. We'll file follow-up to patch sanitizer.

samir: Session created: session-id=ses-9a3b (will redact in GH). Starting collection.

joanne: Thanks; logging watchers on. :eyes:
